crossRefs.note: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Moladah
people.line: Town in the Negev, allotted to Judah and Simeon

translations.web: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
translations.kjv: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,
translations.asv: And they had for their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,
